title: 第二十五章：密室（中）
content_zh:
虽然已经打开了密室，但贺烈却并没有急着进去，而是又走到右侧书架前，又拿起另一个玉匣，然后依照先前的一番做法，又将玉匣调换了一下，然后又将刚换下的玉匣放到了第一次拿出玉匣的那个空位之中。

    如果不是亲眼看到贺烈刚才的一番动作，只是看着眼前的书架，完全发现不了有人动过，这倒不是贺峰眼力太差，而实在是书架上放的这些玉匣，若是单从外观上看，完全一样，根本分辨不出有什么区别，更不要说还要记清楚玉匣放的位置了。

    不过，这也难不到贺峰，先前因为以为自己要开始在书架上选书，所以他也曾留心观察过这个书架，书架的材质似乎很是特殊，如石似玉，但看上去却又和普通的木质极为相似，通体皆是古黄色，上下共分五层，书架上每一层都被隔板隔成了大小不同的数个空档，而每一层所隔出的空当的大小与数量也并不一样，这明显是为这些书做了分类，但令贺峰感到疑惑的是，虽然已经做好了分类，但却并没有什么标识可以用来辨明这些书的类别。无奈，贺峰为了记住先前那三个玉匣所放的具体位置，只好动用自己压箱底的绝学知识——坐标。

    第一个玉匣，位置在书架第三层右数第二个空挡中右数第五，于是便被贺峰称为三二五号玉匣，以此类推，第二个玉匣的代号为五七三，第三个玉匣的代号为二四一。

    在贺峰看来，密室的开启方式设置的这样隐秘，而且复杂，自然是可以有效防止自己藏在密室中的秘密外泄，但密室的作用似乎，应该，并不只是用来藏东西的，关键时刻，更是可以救命用的，但只是开启就这么麻烦，真的很难想象，如果真的到了那一刻，敌人会给自己那么多时间来让自己开启密室，除非那人的目的，就是打开密室。

    贺烈抱起贺峰，转身向着密室之内迈进。从外面看，密室是黑洞洞的一片，但进入密室后，却又是另一番光景，明亮而不刺眼，通道并不如何宽广，只能容的下一个人通行无碍，高也不过只是比贺烈略高少许。

    如果省去密室开启的时间不算的话，只看这个通道，还是比较适合关键时刻逃命用的，贺峰在心中不断的评价着。贺峰几次三番的出现这样的想法，倒不是因为贺峰胆小怕死，而是他习惯了这样的思考方式，这种习惯是经历过不知道多少次的死里逃生后，养成的深入灵魂的习惯。凡是能够利用起来，但凡能够在关键时刻保命的东西，他就从来都不会嫌多，尽管眼前用不到，但人生路还很长不是？他之所以能那么命大的与死神一次又一次的擦肩而过，就是因为他总能在关键时刻，拿出一张又一张的保命底牌。

    贺烈抱着贺峰刚进入密室，原本分成两半的书架，马上就又合拢在了一起，反应速度快的直令贺峰目瞪口呆，这速度，简直比感应门也不遑多让啊。

    还没来得及感叹这个世界的神奇，便又被贺烈抱着转回了身形，面对着合拢后的书架的背侧。

    贺烈抽出原本抱着贺峰的一只手，不知从什么地方拿出半颗如石似玉的古黄色珠子，珠子约有鸽子蛋大小，上面刻画着很多的纹路。只见贺烈将珠子的截面朝外，缓缓摁进了书架背侧的一个小凹槽内，这个凹槽刚好在书架一分为二的那条线上，如果不仔细看，还真发现不了这里还有个小凹槽，如果不是看到眼前这半颗小珠子，更想不到这个小凹槽竟是一个开关的枢纽。

    贺峰觉得自己以后再也不相信电视上放的那些机关暗道的设计了，虽然不知道这条通道后面藏着什么东西，但贺峰觉得，真正的好东西所藏的地方，就在这个开关的后面。

    贺烈将珠子放入凹槽后，贺峰就开始细心地注意着周围的变化，就在他疑惑周围为什么没有什么通道出现的时候，他突然觉得自己在向下掉，低头一看，才发现，不知什么时候，自己已经掉到了一个深坑之中。

    贺峰很不理解，既然进入密道之后，还有密道，那刚开始开启密室的方法为什么要那么麻烦呢？这不是很明显在给敌人灭杀自己的时间吗？贺峰觉得只有快速的打开密道，然后再次迅速的开启第二条密道，这样才是最正确的方法，也才是在关键时刻最能保命的方式，不过，贺峰却再也不敢随便轻视这个世界上人们的智慧了，所以同时他也觉得，自己之所以想不明白，一定是还有着某些事情是自己不知道的，而这些事情，才是这两个密道开启的关键所在。

    下落的过程并没有持续太长的时间，也只是贺峰一闪念的功夫，便已经落了地，当然，有一个武皇修为的父亲做保镖，贺峰并没有感受到这个深坑之中有什么危险存在。

    落下地来，之间漆黑一片，当然这是对于普通人而言，而无论是已经拥有武皇修为的贺烈还是毫无修为的贺峰，都不能算是普通人。对于贺烈来讲，这种环境对他并没有太大影响；而贺峰则是因为先前九彩世界的破碎以及融入自身之后，他便也能夜间视物，夜，对他来讲，不过是一片黑色的迷雾罢了，所以只是视线范围受到了很大的限制而已，但这也比那些普通人强上许多倍了。

    落地之后，贺烈也并没有停止动作，或是做什么点灯之类的动作，而是不断地前后左右的移动着，由于贺峰是被贺烈抱在怀中，所以也只知道移动的方向是前后还是左右，但并无法判断出到底是走了几步。贺峰看着周围的有些模糊景物，已经判断出了行进的方向，并不是前方，而是右前方，只不过因为贺烈自从掉下来之后，便再没有变换过所面对的方向，所以刚开始的时候，贺峰一直以为自己在前进。

    不断前进右行，不时还后退左移几次，不知道重复了多少次，终于站在了这间地下黑密室的右边的墙根下。贺峰正心想，难道这面墙有什么不为人知的秘密不成？难道不能直接过来？一定要费那么大劲？

    正在贺峰陷入不断的我推测中时，贺烈不知从墙上的什么地方又拿出了一只火折子，然后又在墙上的某个位置，点燃了一盏灯，贺峰只看到这盏灯刚刚亮起，这盏灯的两侧，便犹如两只狰狞的火龙，迅速沿着墙壁上固有的轨道蔓延开来，只是这些导火的轨道，上下曲折蜿蜒，若不是提前知道那是火，说不定他真得会以为自己见到了传说中的龙了呢。

    只是瞬间，贺峰见到墙上已经蔓延了三道火线，原来墙上导火的轨道，以之前点燃的那只灯盏为中点位置，右侧那道火线蜿蜒向上，而左侧那道火线则是蜿蜒向下，几乎是同时，两道火线蔓延到了尽头。就在贺峰还沉浸在刚才看到的那震撼的一幕，并且以为事情发展到这里，也算是告一段落了的时候，却又猛然见到在两道火线的尽头处，同时迸射出一道道极细的火线，也直到这个时候，贺峰才注意到，原来在密室的正中央还有着一个巨大的火盆，左侧那道迸射而出的火线，正是朝着这个火盆而来；而右侧的那道迸射而出的火线，却是朝着火盆正上方的那个双色琉璃盏而去。

    只是瞬间，密室大亮，周围的温度也快速的上升着。而贺峰，却盯着那个琉璃盏看了起来，若说先前的那一幕幕，是一个视觉上的盛宴，让他感到震撼，但与这个琉璃盏比起来却又差了太远太远了，哪怕“十万八千里”也失去了它平时的威力，无法彰显出这种震撼上的差距。

    若说只是一个琉璃盏，也并不能带给他如此多的震撼，毕竟贺峰真的是一个见过世面的人，虽然他现在还只有两岁不到。贺峰之所以如此震撼，完全是因为他知道一个双色琉璃盏所代表的意义！

    琉璃盏，共分九中，分别是纯色琉璃盏、双色琉璃盏、•三光琉璃盏、四光琉璃盏、五彩琉璃盏、六彩琉璃盏、七彩至尊琉璃珠、帝尊琉璃珠、祭神珠，这九种琉璃盏中，色彩越多、越纯净，就越是珍贵，而传说中，存世的最为珍贵的琉璃盏，便藏在武朝大内之中，而那只琉璃盏也不过只是一支五彩琉璃盏而已，可是现在，贺峰却在自家的密室之中，见到了一支双色琉璃盏，这是什么概念？这又意味着什么？

    若是几天以前，贺峰顶多也就觉得这样的琉璃盏好看些而已，就算放在他的面前，他最多也只会以欣赏的态度把玩一下，等到把玩够了，说不定还会直接扔到某个垃圾堆里去，因为这样的琉璃盏，毕竟单从外表上看去，除了休闲时拿出来欣赏把玩一下，就再无其他用处了。

    但现在，贺峰却知道了一些关于这些琉璃盏的秘密，所以他震撼的无以复加，所以他不能理解，自己家的密室竟然会有一支琉璃盏，更为关键的是，它是双色的！

    欲知后事如何，且看下回分解。

    有票的捧个票、场，没票、的，捧个人场，谢了、、、
content_en:
Although the secret room had been opened, He Lie did not rush in. Instead, he walked to the bookshelf on the right and picked up another jade box. Then he changed the jade box again according to the previous method, and then placed the jade box he had just replaced into the empty space where he took out the jade box for the first time.
If you hadn't witnessed He Lie's actions just now, and just looked at the bookshelf in front of you, you couldn't find anyone moving at all. This is not because He Feng has poor eyesight, but because the jade boxes on the bookshelf are exactly the same from the appearance alone. You can't tell the difference at all, let alone remember the location of the jade boxes.
However, this was not difficult for He Feng. Previously, because he thought he was going to start selecting books on the bookshelf, he had also observed this bookshelf carefully. The material of the bookshelf seemed to be very special, like stone and jade, but it looked very similar to ordinary wood. The whole body was antique yellow, and it was divided into five layers.The first floor was divided into several spaces of different sizes by partitions, and the sizes and numbers of the spaces separated by each floor were also different. This was obviously a way to classify these books, but what puzzled He Feng was that although the classification had been done, there were no signs to identify the categories of these books.Helpless, in order to remember the specific locations of the three jade boxes, He Feng had to use his unique knowledge on the bottom of the box - the coordinates.
The first jade box was located in the second space from the right on the third floor of the bookshelf, fifth from the right, so it was called Jade Box No. 325 by He Feng. By analogy, the second jade box was code-named 573, and the third jade box was code-named 241.
In He Feng's view, the secret and complicated opening method of the secret room can naturally effectively prevent the secrets he hides in the secret room from being leaked. However, the role of the secret room seems to be not just for hiding things. It can also be used to save lives at critical moments. However, it is so troublesome to open the secret room. It is really hard to imagine that if that moment really comes, the enemy will give him so much time to open the secret room, unless the purpose of that person is to open the secret room.
He Lie picked up He Feng, turned around and walked towards the secret room.From the outside, the secret room is dark, but after entering the secret room, it is a different scene. It is bright but not dazzling. The passage is not very wide, and can only accommodate one person to pass through without hindrance. The height is only slightly higher than He Lie.
If you don't count the time it takes to open the secret room, just looking at this passage is still more suitable for escaping at critical moments, He Feng kept evaluating in his heart.He Feng had such thoughts several times, not because He Feng was timid and afraid of death, but because he was used to this way of thinking. This habit was developed after he had experienced countless escapes from death, and it was a habit that penetrated deeply into the soul.He would never have too much of anything that could be used, anything that could save his life at a critical moment. Even though he didn't need it right now, he still had a long way to go in life, right?The reason why he is so lucky to have a close brush with death again and again is because he can always pull out life-saving trump cards at critical moments.
As soon as He Lie entered the secret room with He Feng in his arms, the bookshelf that was originally divided into two parts immediately came together again. He Feng was stunned by the speed of reaction. This speed was even faster than the induction door.
Before he had time to sigh at the magic of this world, He Lie turned him around again, facing the back of the closed bookshelf.
He Lie took out the hand that was originally holding He Feng and took out half an ancient yellow bead that looked like stone and jade from somewhere. The bead was about the size of a pigeon egg and had many lines carved on it.He Lie turned the cross section of the bead outward and slowly pressed it into a small groove on the back of the bookshelf. This groove was just on the line that bisected the bookshelf. If you didn't look carefully, you wouldn't have noticed that there was a small groove here. If you hadn't seen the half bead in front of you, you wouldn't have thought that this small groove was actually the hub of a switch.
He Feng felt that he would never believe in the design of the secret passages shown on TV again. Although he didn't know what was hidden behind this passage, He Feng felt that the real good things were hidden behind this switch.
After He Lie put the beads into the groove, He Feng began to pay careful attention to the changes around him. Just when he was wondering why there were no passages around him, he suddenly felt that he was falling downwards. When he looked down, he realized that he had fallen into a deep pit at some point.
He Feng didn't understand. Since there was a secret passage after entering the secret passage, why was it so troublesome to open the secret room at the beginning?Isn't this obviously giving the enemy time to kill him?He Feng felt that the only way to quickly open the secret passage, and then quickly open the second secret passage, was the most correct way, and the most life-saving way at the critical moment. However, He Feng no longer dared to underestimate the wisdom of people in this world, so at the same time, he also felt that the reason why he could not figure it out must be that there must be some things that he did not know, and these things were the key to opening the two secret passages.
The process of falling did not last too long, and it only took He Feng a flash of thought before he landed. Of course, with his father who was a martial emperor as a bodyguard, He Feng did not feel that there was any danger in this deep pit.
When they fell to the ground, everything was pitch black. Of course, this was for ordinary people, and neither He Lie, who already had the martial arts cultivation level, nor He Feng, who had no cultivation level, could be considered ordinary people.For He Lie, this environment did not have much impact on him; and He Feng was able to see at night because of the fragmentation of the nine-color world and the integration into himself. To him, night was just a black fog, so his sight range was greatly restricted, but it was many times better than those of ordinary people.
After landing, He Lie did not stop moving or do anything like lighting a lamp. Instead, he kept moving back, forth, left, and right. Since He Feng was held in He Lie's arms, he only knew whether the direction of movement was forward, backward, or left, but he could not tell how many steps he had taken.He Feng looked at the somewhat blurry scenery around him and already judged that the direction of travel was not forward, but to the right. However, because He Lie had never changed the direction he was facing since he fell, at first, He Feng thought he was moving forward.
I kept moving forward and to the right, and from time to time I went back and moved to the left several times. I didn't know how many times I repeated this, and finally I stood under the right wall of this underground dark room.He Fengzheng was thinking, could there be some unknown secret in this wall?Can't you come directly?Must it take so much effort?
While He Feng was lost in my constant speculation, He Lie took out another fire stick from somewhere on the wall, and then lit a lamp somewhere on the wall. He Feng only saw that the lamp had just turned on, and on both sides of the lamp, there wereLike two ferocious fire dragons, they quickly spread along the inherent tracks on the wall, but these fire tracks were winding up and down. If he hadn't known in advance that it was fire, he might have thought he had seen the legendary dragon.
In just a moment, He Feng saw that three fire lines had spread on the wall. It turned out that the fire track on the wall had the previously lit lamp as its midpoint. The fire line on the right was winding upward, while the fire line on the left was winding downward. Almost at the same time, the two fire lines spread to the end.Just when He Feng was still immersed in the shocking scene he had just seen, and thought that the matter had come to an end at this point, he suddenly saw extremely thin lines of fire shooting out from the ends of the two lines of fire. Until this time, He FengFengcai noticed that there was a huge brazier in the center of the secret room. The line of fire on the left was heading towards this brazier, while the line of fire on the right was heading towards the two-color glazed lamp directly above the brazier.
In just an instant, the secret room lit up, and the surrounding temperature rose rapidly.But He Feng stared at the glazed lamp. If the previous scene was a visual feast that shocked him, but compared with this glazed lamp, it was far, far behind. Even "One Hundred and Eight Thousand Miles" had lost its usual power and could not show this shocking gap.
If it were just a glass lamp, it wouldn't be able to shock him so much. After all, He Feng was really a person who had seen the world, even though he was still less than two years old.The reason why He Feng was so shocked was entirely because he knew the meaning of a two-color glass lamp!
The glazed lamps are divided into nine categories, namely, solid-color glazed lamps, two-color glazed lamps, three-light glazed lamps, four-light glazed lamps, five-color glazed lamps, six-color glazed lamps, seven-color supreme glazed lamps, emperor glazed lamps, and sacrificial beads. Among these nine types of glazed lamps, the more colors and purer they are, the more beautiful they are.It is precious, and according to legend, the most precious glazed lamp in existence is hidden in the Wu Dynasty, and that glazed lamp is just a five-color glazed lamp. But now, He Feng saw a two-color glazed lamp in his secret room. What is this concept?What does this mean?
A few days ago, He Feng would have thought that such a glazed lamp would look better at most. Even if it were placed in front of him, he would only play with it with an appreciative attitude. When he has played with it enough, he might just throw it into a garbage dump, because after all, based on the appearance, such a glazed lamp has no other use than taking it out to appreciate and play with in leisure time.
But now, He Feng knew some secrets about these glazed lamps, so he was shocked beyond measure. Therefore, he could not understand that there was a glazed lamp in the secret room of his home. More importantly, it was two-color!
